title: Hollow Wake
author: mrmicky1992
selftext:
I've been working on my first game, [Hollow Wake](https://mrmicky.itch.io/hollow-wake), ChatGPT describes it as a fantasy bullet heaven roguelite built in Godot... I've finally got it to a point where I'm comfortable sharing it. I have played a lot of Risk of Rain 2, Binding of Isaac, Vampire Survivors etc. You can hopefully see that in the game.

Solo creator, and I want to be upfront about the fact that **AI has played a massive role in making this game possible.**

I have a computer science background, and experience working in IT. However, I'm certainly not an experienced programmer or game artist (Have had an unrelated job for the past 10 years).

I've been using AI tools, mainly ChatGPT and Codex, to help with programming, game mechanics, animations, UI, and other parts of development.

My role has largely been coming up with the ideas, deciding how things should work, directing the development, testing everything, and going back and forth fixing things that don't work or just aren't good enough.

And there's been a LOT of that last part.

The game itself has procedural dungeons, different characters with unique abilities, weapons, relics, bosses, and local co-op. There's still plenty that needs improving, particularly the visuals, animations, and general polish.

It's an early project, and I'm learning as I go. But it's been genuinely enjoyable doing some runs (on medium because hard and insane are too hard for me).

I've just put an early build on [itch.io](https://mrmicky.itch.io/hollow-wake) 

I'd really appreciate any feedback
